output:
## When to use
Use the `Layout` template for page-level structure that wraps atoms, molecules, and organisms. The `Skeleton` directory was an extra, non-standard layer in this template and has been removed to maintain consistency across all templates.

Files changed:
- Deleted `templates/chota-angular-ngrx/src/ui/templates/Skeleton/` (including `.gitkeep`, `Layout.component.html`, `Layout.component.spec.ts`, `Layout.component.ts`, `Layout.stories.ts`, `Layout.style.css`).

Why: The `template-integrity` check flagged `chota-angular-ngrx/ui/templates` for containing an extra `Skeleton` directory, while the standard across all other templates is to only provide `Layout`. Removing the duplicate `Skeleton` folder aligns the directory structure with the shared atomic architecture convention.
